ns2:section.sectionText: By engaging in a competitive simulation, students will be introduced to the business functions of finance, marketing, operations, and their strategic integration for business success. In addition, a focus on important soft skills will enhance the students’ capacity as a professional. Finally, the course is designed to engage and build students to become the next business leaders.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to College of Business. Restricted to students with Sophomore class standing.
